title: Shell execution context
summary: Understand PATH, shebang, permissions, working directory and non-interactive execution differences.

concepts.title: Command lookup
concepts.explanation: Shells use builtins, functions and PATH lookup according to the current process environment.

concepts.title: Script execution
concepts.explanation: Direct execution also depends on filesystem execute permission, path traversal, mount policy and the shebang interpreter.

concepts.title: Automation context
concepts.explanation: Cron, Jenkins and systemd frequently run with a different user, PATH, shell and working directory.

limitations: A command working interactively does not prove it works under automation.
Permission denied should not be “fixed” with broad permissions without identifying the blocked boundary.
